influences.name: Charlie Parker
influences.context: That's what we heard: Charlie Parker and Dizzy Gillespie got played instead of the pops of the day.

influences.name: Frank Zappa
influences.context: No influences, but certainly one of my loves. "Peaches En Regalia" and the Hot Rats album. We actually played with him.

influences.name: Miles Davis
influences.context: I equate it with someone like Miles Davis. Miles Davis made Kind Of Blue — I still play the record because I love it — but he never did. He always moved on. He always played something different.
